description: This file defines the 'Drug' class in the OpenMRS project; it models a drug entity with properties such as concept, dosage form, doses, strength, and related references, used for managing medication data in the system.

classes.name: Drug
classes.description: Represents a drug entity with metadata and references, including dosage, strength, and related concepts.

methods.name: getDrugId
methods.description: Returns the internal unique identifier for the drug.

methods.name: setDrugId
methods.description: Sets the internal unique identifier for the drug.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the drug, including its concept name if available.

methods.name: isCombination
methods.description: Deprecated method; returns whether the drug is a combination drug.

methods.name: getCombination
methods.description: Returns whether the drug is a combination drug.

methods.name: setCombination
methods.description: Sets whether the drug is a combination drug.

methods.name: getStrength
methods.description: Retrieves the strength string of the drug.

methods.name: setStrength
methods.description: Sets the strength string of the drug.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept linked to this drug.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Links a concept to this drug.

methods.name: getDosageForm
methods.description: Gets the concept representing the dosage form.

methods.name: setDosageForm
methods.description: Sets the concept representing the dosage form.

methods.name: getMaximumDailyDose
methods.description: Returns the maximum daily dose allowed for this drug.

methods.name: setMaximumDailyDose
methods.description: Sets the maximum daily dose for this drug.

methods.name: getMinimumDailyDose
methods.description: Returns the minimum daily dose for this drug.

methods.name: setMinimumDailyDose
methods.description: Sets the minimum daily dose for this drug.

methods.name: getIngredients
methods.description: Retrieves the collection of ingredients associated with this drug.

methods.name: setIngredients
methods.description: Sets the collection of ingredients for this drug.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Implementation of OpenmrsObject#getId, returning the drug's ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Implementation of OpenmrsObject#setId, setting the drug's ID.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for display purposes.

methods.name: getDrugReferenceMaps
methods.description: Returns the set of drug reference maps, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: setDrugReferenceMaps
methods.description: Sets the collection of drug reference maps.

methods.name: addDrugReferenceMap
methods.description: Adds a drug reference map to the drug, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: getDoseLimitUnits
methods.description: Returns the units for dose limits.

methods.name: setDoseLimitUnits
methods.description: Sets the units for dose limits.
